shared_elements: schematic human figure with stick-like limbs
linear grooved lines crossing the surface
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic stick-limbed human-like figures combined with concentric-circle/ring motifs and long straight grooved lines, a fairly specific combination of rock-art conventions. However, A is a single isolated figure whose head IS the concentric circle, arranged with two isolated horizontal lines, while B is a crowded multi-figure composition with elongated limbs, arcs and scattered cupmarks, so the specific relationships and layout differ substantially.
